Gemma is provided under and subject to the Gemma Terms of Use found at ai.google.dev/gemma/terms.

RISE uses public, revision-pinned MLC conversions of the Gemma models. Original model weights are not included in this source repository. The browser downloads the selected model from the upstream model repository only when the user prepares or compares it.

The Gemma Terms of Use and Gemma Prohibited Use Policy are included as GEMMA_TERMS.txt and GEMMA_PROHIBITED_USE.txt. Use of these models through RISE is subject to those terms and use restrictions. RISE is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
